tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lcag ge dge slong rin chen bzang po la gdams pa'i zhus lan 'od phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/na mo gu ru dharmāḥrā dza ya/ rnam dkar 'od stong phyogs brgyar g.yo ba'i sku// rnam mang legs bshad chos sgra sgrog pa'i gsung*// rnam grol zung 'jug bde stong rol pa'i thugs// rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// ces mchod par brjod pa sngon du drangs nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i skyabs yul dam par gyur pa/ zla bral thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rje rin po che'i drung du/ slob ma'i tha chung dge slong rgyal mtshan bzang pos/ thog mar skye med spros bral ma'i gsol 'debs 'di ltar 'bul te/ na mo gu ru lo ka nā tha yā/ skye med spros bral chos sku'i mkha' dbyings la// zag med bde chen longs sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// 'gag med thugs rje sprul sku'i tsha zer 'phros// thub bstan pad+mo'i gnyen gcig po la 'dud// kun khyab chos nyid mkha' las ma g.yos kyang*// zag med dga' bzhis cha shas yongs rdzogs shing*// rin chen bdud rtsi'i bsil zer spro mkhas pa// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid// 'phags mchog klu sgrub snying po'i rnam par 'phrul// 'jig rten mgon po mnyam med 'bri gung pa// rgyal ba kun dga' rin chen zhabs la 'dud// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku// 'gag med grag stong yan lag drug cu'i gsung*// mkhyen gnyis mngon gyur bde stong rol pa'i thugs// rgyal ba kun dga' rin chen zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan// khyad par sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gnyen gcig pu// rgyal ba kun dga' rin chen zhabs la 'dud// rab 'byams zab rgyas chos kyi gangs ri la// rnam dpyod blo gros lus stobs rab rgyas shing*// lung rigs legs bshad sgra dbyangs sgrog mkhas pa// 'jigs med smra ba'i seng ge'i zhabs la 'dud// bslab gsum rgyan spras 'phags tshogs 'dus pa'i sku// theg gsum 'byung gnas dam chos bdud rtsi'i gsung*// sku gsum mngon gyur dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs// mchog gsum ngo bo drin can chos rje la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// phyi nang gsang gsum kun bzang mchod pa 'bul// sgrib gsum mi dge'i tshogs kun mthol lo bshags// dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// stong gsum zhing kun chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// srid gsum 'gro ba'i dpal du zhabs brtan cing*// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba kun// 'khor gsum yongs dag byang chub chen por bsngo// mgon khyod mkhyen rtse'i pad tshal rab rgyas pa// bdag sogs gdul bya bung ba'i dpal gyur nas// zab don sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi nyams rgyas shing*// chos dbyings mkha' la bde stong rol bar shog

/bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden stobs kyis// 'jig rten mgon po kun dga' rin chen gyi// sku tshe ring zhing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /de ltar rab gus gdung bas gsol btab pas// bdag sogs deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// thams cad mkhyen pa chos rje'i zhabs pad dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med par shog /rtag tu thugs rje'i brtse bas rjes bzung nas// tshul gnas thos bsam zab mo'i don sgom zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i// sras kyi thu bo dam par bdag gyur cig /zhes bstod de/ 'di yi nyer 'phros snyan du sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag bgyis te gsol pa/ sku yi nyin byed mi mthun phyogs kyi chu 'dzin gyis ma gos shing*/ gsung dbyangs legs bshad tsha zer gyis gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi pad tshal ches cher rgyas pa nas/ thugs rje mkhyen rtse'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor byed cing*/ bdag sogs skye dgu thams cad kyi blo yi rgud pa dang ma rig pa'i mun nag drungs nas 'byin cing*/ sgrib gnyis bag chags kyi tshang tshing sreg bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ slar yang sgyu 'phrul chen po'i zlos gar gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mdzad pa phrin las rlabs po che mdzad pa'i phyir ram/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rje nyid kyi mdzad pa gnyis pa ston pa'i ched dam/ 'khor 'das thams cad la bde legs dang bkra shis pa'i sgo mang zhing*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i slad du/ rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang rat+na tsar+ya'i mchod rten bzhengs pa grub tu nye bar bzhugs zhes pa'i snyan grags kyi bdud rtsi'i bsil zer/ rna ba'i dbang por lhung bas yid kyi ku mud yongs su rgyas par gyur lags/ bdag kyang rje nyid la mos gus rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas sgo gsum dben pa'i ri khrod du/

ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don dang*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i phyir du/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs shing*/ nyams len ched du bya ba mos gus srog 'khor dang*/ zab mo lnga ldan gnyis la gnad du bsnun pa la glo bur du lus la 'byung bzhi'i nad mi zad pa phog ste/ lus srog bral bar nye ba tsam du byung bas/ rje nyid la gsol ba btab cing*/ nad thog tu bzhag pa las spros pa ma byas/ stag lung nas gdan zur/ bla ma mched grogs rnams kyi bka' nan cher phebs nas sman dpyad sogs bsten kyang*/ phan pa rdul tsam yang ma byung*/ slar yang bla ma bsam gtan gling pa'i zhabs drung du phyin pas skyed byung*/ gting thon pa tsam ni ma byung*/ nad rgyun lo gsum song*/ 'byung bzhi rgud/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor blta bar 'dod pas skom pa chu 'dod pa tsam yod kyang ma sleb pa lags/ khyad par bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'das mchod dang*/ dge 'dun mi 'thor bar dbyar tshul bzhugs kyi ya bu/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul bar bsdad pas/ da lan sgom chen gnyis zhabs drung du btang ba'i don bla ma'i mchog bsngo dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi bsam don dngos po chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam dang rten 'brel mkhyen mkhyen/ de yang thams cad mkhyen pa rje nyid 'khor 'das thams cad la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ sems can thams cad kyi khams dang bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal dang*/ dbang po'i bye brag sogs la lkog gyur gyi tshul thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa thugs kyi mi bas pas/ bdag la bla ma mang du bzhugs kyang*/ chos rje 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi rnam thar la slob 'dod yod kyang sa thag 'gyangs/ da lta rje khyed rang dang zhal mjal tshun nas mos gus kyi snang ba thob/ thugs rjes mchog tu bzung nas/ chos drin kyang 'khor med du che bas/

tshe 'di phyi thams cad du re sa dang bsam rgyu rje las med pa mkhyen bzhin du/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis gzigs shing*/ thugs rjes rtag tu gzung du gsol byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ slar yang smre sngags kyi bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa 'di ltar gsol ba ni/ rje drin can chos kyi rgyal po la// bus mos gus kyi gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs// rang sems stong nyid kyi nam mkha' la// mos gus kyi chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs shing*// gsol 'debs kyi 'brug sgra cher bsgrags pa'i// gdong 'chi mas gang ba'i ngang tshul 'di// rje mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis rab gzigs nas// gegs skyon gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// nyams rtogs yon tan smin pa dang*// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bdag 'dra sprang ban spong ba bas// zang zing gi 'bul ba ma mchis shing*// lus ngag gi zhabs tog yang ma grub// grub rtags kyi yon tan ma skyes par// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang po la// 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang bskur dang*// lhan cig skyes sbyor ngo sprod dang*// zhabs rjes ma yi rab gnas dang*// bu yi thig le'i gegs sel dang*// rje yi gsang ba'i rnam thar sogs// 'dod pa shin tu mang ba 'di// rigs par yang ni ma 'os kyang*// bsam rgyu chos las med pas na// tshe 'di blos btang ri khrod 'grim// sgrub pa snying por blangs nas kyang*// ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus rnams su// dal 'byor lus can ldan nas kyang*// pha 'jig rten gsum mgon rin chen gyi// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i smon lam btab// 'gro la phan 'dod kyi lhag bsam 'di// rgyun mi 'chad par thugs bskyed dang*// sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bur lta// nyams chung dhā dzā bha dra la// myur du thob pa'i smon lam mkhyen// bdag 'dra skal ba dman pa'i bsod snyoms pa// thos bsam blo gros sbyangs pa'i lus nyams shing*// nyams rtogs yon tan blta ba'i mig bu long*// mos gus tsam gyi 'khar ba la brten nas// sa bcu lam lnga mngon du rab gyur cing*// tshogs sbyor gnyis la ngal gso mi byed pa// mthong sgom lam mchog myur du bgrod nas kyang*// mthar phyin lam la bde blag 'dren mdzad gsol// zhes zhu yig spyan zur g.yo ba'i rten du gsol ja bzang po dkar gang ma lan gsum zhus pa'i thog

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i gser sku ngo mtshar can gcig zhwa ser gcig dar ras kha bcu/ dkar yol yu thung gcig kar ja nag po sig gcig grwa pa dge 'dun spyi pa rnams kyi mang ja snel po rnams dang bcas pa 'bul/ mchog bsngo thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu/ bdag sogs deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ khyed sku lhun po'i nyin byed blta ba dang*// khyed gsung zag med bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'thung zhing*// khyed thugs mkhyen gnyis brtse bas rjes 'dzin shog /zhes pa/ dpal stag lung gi sa yi cha se tsha chos lung gi ri khrod nas/ bya bral pen+dha bas 'gyur med mos gus kyi ngang nas zhus pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ //oṃ bde legs su gyur cig bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shākya'i dge slong rgyal mtshan bzang po'i ri mo/ chos skyes kyi me tog nyams rtogs kyi mchod pa/ mkhas grub kyi legs bshad/ zang zing gi dngos po rgya chen po dang bcas pa 'phrod pas/ rjes su yi rang zhing spro/ 'di phyogs su 'ang kho bo cag 'dus pa dang bcas pa khams gzugs snyoms shing*/ ji ltar brjod pa'i phreng ba spel legs pa ltar/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu 'bras mi slu ba'i bden pa mngon du byed pa dang*/ sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rten 'brel ri mo'i lugs mi nyams par byed pa dang*/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams gsog pa'i mig rten du/ rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang rat+na tsar+ya'i mchod rten bzhengs pa grub tu nye ba rang du yod/ khyed yon tan ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ bla ma dam pa la dus mtha'i mos gus phul ba'i rten 'brel gyi 'khor 'das kyi yon tan/ khyad par du 'ang sgom byung gi shes rab nang nas shar/ gsol 'debs tshig don gyi legs bshad sgro skur dang bral ba byung ba snang bas/ slar yang rjes su yi rang*/

rtogs pa skye ba'i snga ltas su bar chad 'byung bar bshad de/ a mo gha pa sha las/ gang tshe dngos grub 'byung ba na// de tshe las ni ldog par 'gyur// zhes/ khams ma bde ba chen po byung 'dug kyang*/ bar chad kyi gnod par ma nus shing*/ nyams rtogs kyi bogs rtsal thon/ dge khar stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar ba'i bcos kha sogs legs 'dug da dung sman bcos dang ro snyoms sogs la le bar med gal che/ 'dir sngar ma phyin pa cis kyang bden par snang*/ bla ma dam pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dang*/ khyad par dbyar mtshams grwa pa rnams tshul ma zhig pa'i ya phu byed pa de shin tu legs snang*/ khong sbrel po dang thug yig rten smon lam rten rnams blangs/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab yod/ khyed rang cis kyang sleb pa bgyis/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang dang phyag chen lhan gcig skyes sbyor sogs ster bar byed/ gdams ngag chud ma zos shing*/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa skyob pa rin po che'i chos mdzod 'dzin pa rang du snang bas de ltar du 'gyur ba'i smon lam byed par yod/ sku 'dra zhabs rjes ma lung mthun snang bas/ rab gnas cho ga mnga' dbul gzhung dang mthun zhing byin chags pa byas yod/ gsol 'debs skye med spros bral ma legs rang snang bas bcos dgos pa mi 'dug rang gzhan nyams len byas pa rang gi chog pa snang*/ gsang ba'i rnam thar lung thob pa legs/ bshus nas bskur yod/ kun dga' tshul khrims kyi gegs sel gyis lung byas bskur yod/ skyob pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi man ngag yin/ grwa pa rnams kyi ja zhus dang smon lam rten blangs mchog bsngo rgyas par byas yod/ khyed kyi chab tsha gser sku sogs shin tu legs pa byung*/ gong du brjod ltar khyed rang gi yid la bsam pa dang*/ ngag tu brjod pa rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam shin tu byed pa yod/ da len dad rten du dmigs te/

rnag gzan gyon 'phro zhig gis dril/ tshas la rgyas btab pa yod// slar yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ khyod sngon bsags bsod nams che bas na// da lta mi lus rin chen thob// thub pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// tshig gsum bsnyen par rdzogs par byas// de sdom gsum dril ba'i 'byung sa yin// sngar ma nyams phyis kyang mi nyams shing*// stobs bcu'i 'bras bu thob par gyis// gnyis pa lhag bsam ma bskyed na// stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas tshul khrims kyang*// theg pa dman par gol bas na// byang chub thob pa'i gegs su 'gyur// des na byang sems lhag bsam dag /nus ldan dag las blang bar bya// bdag smin gzhan phan brtson par bya// sa lam bar chad dag las grol// dbugs 'byin thob cing phyir mi ldog /da dung tshe gcig sangs rgyas ni// thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bsten// chu 'bog gcig la rje bcang gnyis// lus rten 'di la dka' na yang*/ kha cig gsang sngags dus min smra// smra ba thos chung bsod nams dman// lam log rjes 'brang rab spangs te// rdo rje theg par gnas par bya// lus ngag sems gsum rdo rjer bsgyur// bsgyur byed rdo rje slob dpon la// rdo rje 'chang chen sangs rgyas su// nges pa'i shes pa bskyed par bya// bskyed la smin byed dbang mnos nas// grol byed zab lam bskyed rdzogs bsgom// rang lus gdod nas lha sku la// rten 'brel brda thabs ngo sprod bya// gnas lugs shes pa gtan la phob// 'di yongs grub yin pas btsal mi dgos// kun btags gzhan dbang 'khrul ba'i blo// gshis la mi gnas 'grub mi 'gyur// don spyi bsgom par gyur pas na// don dngos thob par mi 'gyur te// brtan pa thob la ring du 'gyur// de bas gnyis 'dzin spangs nas ni// gnyis med ye shes brtan par gyis// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni// rdzogs pa'i rim pa dag las bshad// de yang rten 'brel brda thabs dag

/med na mi 'byung nges pas na// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten par bya// rang sems rtogs na 'tshang rgya zhing*// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don chen 'grub// 'di yang gzhan nas btsal du med// nor bu sngags sman 'byor ba ltar// sems la lta dang ma bral na// zhi gnas ting 'dzin bzhi thob nas// mthong spang sgom lam slob pa'i lam// mi slob phyir mi ldog thob 'gyur// kha cig sa lam ma bsgoms shing*// lta ba yas phub rgyu 'bras dor// cig car thod brgal yod ces smra// de yang mthon po'i 'dzin stangs yin// lta ba yod de rtogs pa med// rang re'i rjes 'brang bu slob dag /rtogs pa thob par 'dod pas na// rim gyis dag la slob par bya// rtogs pa goms pa sgom pa yin// sgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med pa de// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag yin// chos rje nyid kyis gsungs pas na// dran pa rgyun chad med par brten// dran pa zhes bya'ang tha snyad yin// de yang kyai'i rdo rje las// gang phyir yid kyis mi bsgoms par// 'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya// gsungs pa'i don de gang zhe na// lta ba khas len bral ba yin// sgom pa yid byed bral ba yin// spyod pa blang dor bral ba yin// 'bras bu lhan skyes rnam gsum yin// de go bar gyis la nyams su longs// dmigs med bsngo ba'i rgya yis thob// chos lnga ldan gyi don tshang dang ngo sprod gnyis// khyod dad ldan gyi slob ma snying stobs can// ban ldom rgyal mtshan bzang po la// snying nas gces par gdams pa yin// dge bas byang chub 'thob par shog/ ༈ //oṃ swa sti/ kha zas kyi sbyor ba ngan pa// sman dang 'gred kyis bsrung bar dka' ba yod de/ thig le nyams pa dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ skyug pa dang*/ tshad pa'i nad kyi btab pa la sogs pa la srung bas mi thub pa lags/ rten 'brel gyi sbyor ba gzhan yang rten 'brel mi 'grigs pas bsrung bar dka' ba lags/

sngags 'di nga rang yid ches pas/ gnod pa srung bar nus pa lags pas/ dang po byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ sngags 'di la stong tsho gsum yan ci mang bskyal/ dal ba'i dus su yang ci mang bskyal/ de nas yid mi ches pa'i kha zas dang 'phrad na/ dang por byang chub kyi sems dang lha bsgom/ kha zas la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum bzlas pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir dkar mer la gyur par bsam/ de la nyi shu rtsa gcig yan chad bzlas la/ sngags bzla zhing*/ za ba ni bza' btung gis bsrung ba'o// khong du song zin na/ bza' rgyu dang*/ btung ba mtha' dag dang*/ chu la bzlas shing bza' btung bya ba dang*/ nad la shes pa gtad nas/ bzlas pa byas pas phan pa la tshegs med pa lags so// dpe'i kro na/ bhi ha na/ bhas bha ba/ phu gang to to shi/ to ti bhis/ dza dzā/ kha gro gro/ kha gro gro/ dug se/ tog se/ swe to/ tod ci nan//
hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes grangs bzang po la gdan sa 'bri gung byang chub gling nas bris pa dge legs yar ngo zla ltar 'phel gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ//
